summary: Northern Oil and Gas, Inc. filed an 8-K to report the pricing of a private offering of $500 million aggregate principal amount of 7.500% senior notes due 2034 at par. The offering is expected to close on August 26, 2026. Net proceeds will repay a portion of outstanding revolving credit facility borrowings, with remainder for general corporate purposes. The notes are offered under Rule 144A and Regulation S and are not registered. This is a routine debt issuance, not a special situation involving equity events, M&A, or restructuring. No special-situation category applies; the filing is an ordinary capital markets transaction.
